title.zh: 【CFTC 主席：拟允许交易所提供加密现货杠杆交易，倍数将与永续合约市场一致】
title.en: 【CFTC 主席：拟允许交易所提供加密现货杠杆交易，倍数将与永续合约市场一致】

current_state.zh: CFTC Chair Michael Selig said the proposed Reg CTX rule would allow exchanges to offer retail margin, leverage and financing on crypto spot trading with requirements aligned to perpetual futures (~7x max), while companion Reg CAM would create a federal 'crypto asset market' license for spot-leverage-only exchanges, with finalization targeted within months.
